description:
Read a page found by search_docs.

Without a heading: the page's description and outline (top-level sections
with subsection counts). With a heading: that section's full text,
including its subsections; continue long sections with next_offset.
outline_depth=3 also lists subsections; use it only on long pages to find
one specific subsection.

heading.description: Heading to read, as listed in the outline (leading #s optional). Exact text first, case-insensitive, then a unique partial match; use 'Parent > Heading' when two headings share a name. Leave unset to get the page's outline.
heading.title: Heading

offset.description: Character offset into the section; pass the previous next_offset to continue a long section.
offset.title: Offset

outline_depth.description: Outline depth when no heading is given: 2 lists top-level sections with subsection counts, 3 also lists the subsections.
outline_depth.title: Outline Depth

url.description: Page URL exactly as search_docs returned it.
url.title: Url

name: read_section

description.description: One sentence on what the page is.
description.title: Description

heading.description: Path of the section returned, e.g. 'Hooks > PreToolUse'; null when only the outline was asked for.
heading.title: Heading

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to read the rest; null when nothing is left.
next_offset.title: Next Offset

outline.description: Top-level sections as '## Text (N subsections)' when no heading was asked for (at most 40 lines, then '+N more sections'); empty otherwise.
outline.title: Outline

text.description: Section markdown from its heading to the next heading of the same or higher level, at most 8,000 characters per call.
text.title: Text

title: Read a section of an agent doc page
